=== A1  include(head)+tag+mc+@file: all accepted ===
+ /home/duxevents/pcrec-bench/build/pcrec-cd371441/build/pcrec --list-source a1.rxt
# pcrec --list-source: the .rxt SOURCE file AS WRITTEN (DD-13b W1).
# One row per head declaration and per pattern block, in FILE ORDER.
# `kind` is the DECLARATION NAME. There is no head/body column: the
# head ends at the first `pattern` row, so a head row is exactly one
# preceding it — a property of the ORDER, which is what the parse
# differential compares.
# AS-WRITTEN, never resolved: `config` composition and the `with`/
# `from` cascades are validated but NOT applied here, because a
# resolved dump would compare pcrec's resolver against no
# counterpart. `--list-source --resolved` is named and unbuilt.
# Columns 4 (`value`), 5 (`pattern`) and 15 (`pcrec`) are escaped in
# the .rxt format's own subject-escape vocabulary (\t \n \r \\ \xNN):
# a `pattern` line is rest-of-line verbatim and may contain a TAB.
# Empty field = none.
#
# [DD-13b.W23.4] Column 5's `pattern` now means TWO things,
# disambiguated by column 19 (`esc`): for a `pattern` block it is
# the line's bytes verbatim; for `pattern-esc` it is the DECODED
# bytes, re-escaped in this same vocabulary. Both deliver the same
# bytes; `esc` says which spelling wrote them.
#
# FOUR `#section` BLOCKS follow the main table, unconditionally
# WHEN NON-EMPTY, never interleaved with it: `provenance`,
# `variants`, `cases` (one row per `m`/`n`/`ms`/`ns`/`mc`/`gu`/`g`/
# `gp` line, `under`-wrapped ones included), `aux` (one row per
# LINE of an `ext` tree, the opener included at depth 0 — its
# contents are dumped faithfully and interpreted by nothing here,
# format_design.md §2.27). No section row's field 1 (always the
# integer `line`) can equal a main-table `kind` token.
#kind	line	name	value	pattern	flags	features	features_only	encoding	engine	budget_steps	budget_frames	with	from	pcrec	export	tags	oracle	esc
include	1	/var/tmp/b42accept41/a1_frag.rxt	"a1_frag.rxt"															
pattern	2	t1		abc												family=wild hazard=none		
#section cases
#line	block_line	block_name	kind	under	startpos	subject_form	subject	subject_id	sha256	start	end	count	giveup	slot	route
5	2	t1	mc		0	inline	"abcabc"					2			default
6	2	t1	m		0	file	a1_subj.bin			0	3				default
EXIT=0

# `kind` is the DECLARATION NAME. There is no head/body column: the
# head ends at the first `pattern` row, so a head row is exactly one
# preceding it — a property of the ORDER, which is what the parse
# differential compares.
# AS-WRITTEN, never resolved: `config` composition and the `with`/
# `from` cascades are validated but NOT applied here, because a
# resolved dump would compare pcrec's resolver against no
# counterpart. `--list-source --resolved` is named and unbuilt.
# Columns 4 (`value`), 5 (`pattern`) and 15 (`pcrec`) are escaped in
# the .rxt format's own subject-escape vocabulary (\t \n \r \\ \xNN):
# a `pattern` line is rest-of-line verbatim and may contain a TAB.
# Empty field = none.
#
# [DD-13b.W23.4] Column 5's `pattern` now means TWO things,
# disambiguated by column 19 (`esc`): for a `pattern` block it is
# the line's bytes verbatim; for `pattern-esc` it is the DECODED
# bytes, re-escaped in this same vocabulary. Both deliver the same
# bytes; `esc` says which spelling wrote them.
#
# FOUR `#section` BLOCKS follow the main table, unconditionally
# WHEN NON-EMPTY, never interleaved with it: `provenance`,
# `variants`, `cases` (one row per `m`/`n`/`ms`/`ns`/`mc`/`gu`/`g`/
# `gp` line, `under`-wrapped ones included), `aux` (one row per
# LINE of an `ext` tree, the opener included at depth 0 — its
# contents are dumped faithfully and interpreted by nothing here,
# format_design.md §2.27). No section row's field 1 (always the
# integer `line`) can equal a main-table `kind` token.
#kind	line	name	value	pattern	flags	features	features_only	encoding	engine	budget_steps	budget_frames	with	from	pcrec	export	tags	oracle	esc
pattern	1	h		a\nb\r														1
EXIT=0

=== D4  the VALIDATES-vs-RECOGNISES table, rendered from --list-schema ===
#section surface
#surface	scope	kind	reason
subject-content	block	m/n/ms/ns/mc	an expectation line is recognised and never read here, so neither a subject's sha256 digest nor its 64-hex spelling is checked by this parser; both are the harness legs' (docs/spec/rxt_format.md)
pattern-text	block	pattern/pattern-esc	the dump is parse-only; pattern text is the compiler's
config-resolution			`--list-source` reports the file AS WRITTEN; which settings a block ends up under is `--source`'s own resolution and is not a (scope, line-kind) fact
ext-tree-contents			the contents of an `ext` tree are never schema-checked and never interpreted; reason: semantically uninterpreted by design (the graduation rule, format_design §2.27.3). The `ext` OPENER's own row is ordinary — the structure is checked, the content by nobody
# schema-rows: 66

# pcrec --list-source: the .rxt SOURCE file AS WRITTEN (DD-13b W1).
# One row per head declaration and per pattern block, in FILE ORDER.
# `kind` is the DECLARATION NAME. There is no head/body column: the
# head ends at the first `pattern` row, so a head row is exactly one
# preceding it — a property of the ORDER, which is what the parse
# differential compares.
# AS-WRITTEN, never resolved: `config` composition and the `with`/
# `from` cascades are validated but NOT applied here, because a
# resolved dump would compare pcrec's resolver against no
# counterpart. `--list-source --resolved` is named and unbuilt.
# Columns 4 (`value`), 5 (`pattern`) and 15 (`pcrec`) are escaped in
# the .rxt format's own subject-escape vocabulary (\t \n \r \\ \xNN):
# a `pattern` line is rest-of-line verbatim and may contain a TAB.
# Empty field = none.
#
# [DD-13b.W23.4] Column 5's `pattern` now means TWO things,
# disambiguated by column 19 (`esc`): for a `pattern` block it is
# the line's bytes verbatim; for `pattern-esc` it is the DECODED
# bytes, re-escaped in this same vocabulary. Both deliver the same
# bytes; `esc` says which spelling wrote them.
#
# FOUR `#section` BLOCKS follow the main table, unconditionally
# WHEN NON-EMPTY, never interleaved with it: `provenance`,
# `variants`, `cases` (one row per `m`/`n`/`ms`/`ns`/`mc`/`gu`/`g`/
# `gp` line, `under`-wrapped ones included), `aux` (one row per
# LINE of an `ext` tree, the opener included at depth 0 — its
# contents are dumped faithfully and interpreted by nothing here,
# format_design.md §2.27). No section row's field 1 (always the
# integer `line`) can equal a main-table `kind` token.
